headline: A federal law officially names the Charlottesville, Virginia, Postal Service facility at 180 McCormick Road the "Captain Humayun Khan Post Office."
what_it_does: The law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service building in Charlottesville, Virginia, the official name of the Captain Humayun Khan Post Office. It changes only the name of the facility. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its hours.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the naming took effect on that date.
